decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen draws directly on the firm's core confectionery know-how, its repeated gold medals from the Deutsches Brotinstitut give clear external feedback that management can interpret, and the firm presents it as a flagship, so it stays.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds on established rye baking skills and, unlike the other new breads that were removed, it kept its own page in 2024, which suggests management has judged its early results as viable.

The marzipan stollen sits close to the award-winning stollen line and uses the same seasonal recipes, production and gift channels, so the firm can maintain it at low cost and with good knowledge of how it performs.
